findings.observed: a SAMPLE pool whose placeholder numbers happened to 'fail' (a mercenary split) rendered AVOID, not UNVERIFIED
findings.rootCause: the pinned verdict precedence ordered 'any fail → AVOID' BEFORE 'reality==SAMPLE → UNVERIFIED' — but a SAMPLE fail is not a verified fail; issuing AVOID on placeholder data dresses SAMPLE as a real judgment (the firewall / S7 explicitly requires every SAMPLE verdict to be UNVERIFIED)
findings.fix: UNVERIFIED now DOMINATES a definitive verdict — deriveVerdict checks reality==SAMPLE (and flagship-uncomputable / >half-uncomputable) BEFORE the fail check. A conscious re-pin (Rule XVII): PINS_SHA ffeb78830d5b… → 8a57e6f196ff…, logged.
findings.retest: S7 green; the emissions/depeg/collapse controls still AVOID on REAL data; battery green
